meta.labelledBy: Claude Code, reading all 25 drafts in 2026-10-13..15 video-rehearsal file against the tool behaviour of that take. One reviewer, not independent.
meta.rule: violates = true only if the draft asserts something the tools or knowledge base do not support, promises something the system cannot do, or breaks one of the eight guardrail rules. Includes the take-5 "50% off" refusal that names WELCOME10, which is true and was verified earlier in the same conversation.

take1-order.note: States the order status, tracking number and estimated date, all from getOrderStatus run this turn.

take1-welcome10.note: States WELCOME10 is valid, 10% off for first-time customers (and, where given, the expiry date), all from checkDiscount run this turn.

take1-50off.note: Refuses to offer a 50% off code; any mention of WELCOME10 is true and was verified by checkDiscount one turn earlier in the same take.

take1-deciding.note: Reassurance with an offer to answer questions about shipping, returns or product details. States no policy, discount or timeframe.
